• Avoid triggering new deploys until we confirm recovery
• Track updates: https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/discussions

We apologize for the inconvenience.

mailTemplates.subject: Important security update — Cursor Curse Monitor by Lorapok v1.0.3
mailTemplates.text:
Please update Cursor Curse Monitor by Lorapok to v1.0.3 or newer as soon as possible.

This release includes security hardening. Never paste API tokens into untrusted sites. Use only cursor.com/dashboard or the extension Options page.

Download: https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/releases/tag/v1.0.3
Support: cursor.curse.help@lorapok.tech

noticeTemplates.label: New features — v1.0.3
noticeTemplates.title: What's new in Cursor Curse Monitor v1.0.3
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: v1.0.3 adds animated stats on the website, Firefox AMO listing fixes, Mission Control deploy validation, and a What's New popup in the browser extension.
noticeTemplates.message:
Cursor Curse Monitor v1.0.3 is rolling out across Open VSX, VS Code Marketplace, Firefox AMO, and GitHub Releases.

Highlights:
• Animated live stats hero on https://cursor.lorapok.tech
• Browser extension What's New card on version bump
• Firefox MV3 manifest compatibility (AMO warnings resolved)
• Mission Control deploy instructions and validation
• Mailbox mail relay for reliable outbound email

Update via your preferred marketplace or download the latest release: https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/releases/tag/v1.0.3

noticeTemplates.label: Bug fix release — v1.0.3
noticeTemplates.title: Bug fixes in v1.0.3
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: Patch v1.0.3 addresses reported issues. Update when convenient — your settings stay on device.
noticeTemplates.message:
We've shipped v1.0.3 with bug fixes and stability improvements for Cursor Curse Monitor.

If you hit an issue on an older build, update to v1.0.3 from Open VSX, VS Code Marketplace, Firefox AMO, or GitHub Releases: https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/releases/tag/v1.0.3

Still stuck? Report details at https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/issues — include your extension version and Cursor version.

noticeTemplates.label: Security advisory
noticeTemplates.title: Security update recommended
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: Please update to the latest release — includes security hardening for token handling and local storage.
noticeTemplates.message:
A security-related improvement is included in the latest Cursor Curse Monitor release.

Action recommended:
1. Update to v1.0.3 or newer from your marketplace or https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/releases/tag/v1.0.3
2. Re-paste your Cursor token only via cursor.com/dashboard or Options — never share tokens in chat or email
3. Review the local security scanner warnings in the extension popup

Questions? Contact cursor.curse.help@lorapok.tech or open https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/issues

noticeTemplates.label: Maintenance window
noticeTemplates.title: Scheduled maintenance — Mission Control
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: Brief maintenance on cursor-dev.lorapok.tech — deployments and mailbox may be unavailable for a short window.
noticeTemplates.message:
Lorapok Labs will perform scheduled maintenance on Mission Control (https://cursor-dev.lorapok.tech).

During this window, admin deploy triggers and mailbox tests may fail temporarily. The marketing site (https://cursor.lorapok.tech) and installed extensions continue to work offline with cached data.

We'll post an all-clear notice when maintenance completes. Follow https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/discussions for updates.

noticeTemplates.label: Conversation recovery (v0.5.15+)
noticeTemplates.title: Recover Missing Agent Conversations
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: Get back chats lost after a worktree switch — v0.5.15+ rebuilds your conversation list safely from saved transcripts.
noticeTemplates.message: If your IDE sidebar lost chats after a worktree switch, branch change, or workspace path mismatch, update to Cursor Curse Monitor v0.5.15 or newer and run Reindex Missing Conversations from the dashboard. The tool rebuilds search and sidebar indexes from on-disk agent transcripts without deleting your existing data.

noticeTemplates.label: Rollback / incident
noticeTemplates.title: Rollback and Recovery Notice
noticeTemplates.shortMessage: We're extremely sorry — an immediate rollback is in progress to restore stability. We'll update you as soon as recovery is confirmed.
noticeTemplates.message: We're extremely sorry for the disruption. We have initiated an immediate rollback to restore the last stable version while we investigate the issue. Please avoid retrying the affected action for now. We'll post an update as soon as recovery is confirmed.
